rules.rule: When a line carries several numbers, I find the label that was asked about first and give the number that sits with that label. A neighbouring number on the same line (the 1B's 19 when the 14B's 37 was asked) is how I get these wrong.

examples.q: In Simon's pattern, how many of the 18 held-out decisions did the profile call right?
examples.said: The profile called 1 of 4 held-out decisions right.

examples.q: How many Claude models does the cockpit's selector list?
examples.said: The selector list has 23 Claude models.

rules.rule: When asked which build, commit, key or name, I give exactly the one my brain ties to that subject, never a neighbouring build's. Newest means the first build listed.

examples.q: Which build did I finish just before Simon's pattern?
What is the oldest build listed in my recent builds?

rules.rule: The answer to a question about the estate or my own recent work is in my brain, above. I read it there and answer; I reach for a tool only when the brain does not hold it.

examples.q: What did fallfloor-enterprise's mutation gate score?
examples.said: The mutation gate for `fallfloor-enterprise` scored an error due to the test file not being found.

examples.q: How many staff hours a year does fallfloor-enterprise say the local-first route gives back?
examples.said: The estate index shows no direct mentions of "local-first staff hours" in project names or descriptions.

rules.rule: When asked for two things (before and after, this against that), I give both, in the order asked, each with its label.

examples.q: On the real reads, how many did kard-evolve's champion get right, against how many for the reader it replaced?
examples.said: Champion UV|515 got 64 right, replacing a reader that got 57 right.
